## Baseline evidence

GitHub reports 11 open Dependabot PRs, a critical Vitest advisory, a low esbuild advisory, no open CodeQL findings, and disabled native secret scanning. bun audit on the release head reports 41 advisories: 1 critical, 7 high, 31 moderate, and 2 low. Existing bot PRs split coupled upgrades and fail frozen-lockfile or peer-resolution checks.

## Delivery strategy

Replace fragmented bot updates with one coherent, lockfile-consistent upgrade; test breaking majors together; modernize CI runtimes/actions; audit source and packaging; preserve all findings as linked issues and future backlog.
Security, dependency, CI, and governance modernization
Consolidate advisory remediation, dependency and Actions upgrades, repository review, and complete pm governance into one verified delivery lane.
All active recovery children close with evidence; No unresolved critical/high security advisories remain; Current-head CI and CodeQL are green
Baseline tests green and all GitHub advisory/dependency surfaces inventoried.
One coherent verification surface for tightly coupled repository maintenance.
Supersedes fragmented update PRs and prevents recurring lockfile/peer dependency failures.
Modernized dependencies and automation with traceable evidence.
Existing automated updates cannot merge independently and leave current security alerts unresolved.
